 This petition coming on for admission this d
 Ravi Malimath, Chief Justice passed the following:
 Order
The plea of the petitioner is, as can be made out from the representation made by him to the various authorities, in terms of Annexure P/1 dated 29.04.2022.
We are of the view that some reasonable time has to be granted to the respondents to act upon the same.
It is not expected that the respondents immediately react to every single letter or representation made to them.
Until and unless a reasonable time is lapsed, it would not be appropriate for the Court to interfere.
Hence, the petition is dismissed being premature.
